_comment: Constituents for the sector treemap. Box area is market capitalisation, colour is
the daily move - the same encoding as the familiar finance heatmaps.
This is a static list of large caps, not a live index membership feed. It drifts as
companies rise and fall out of the top ranks and should be refreshed occasionally.
Prices and market caps come from Yahoo via yfinance in a single bulk request.
Kept to roughly sixty names deliberately: enough for the map to be recognisable,
few enough that every box stays large enough to label.
